newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures buoyant on short covering.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures buoyant on short covering.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat futures trading was buoyant on Tuesday with much of the trade dominated by short covering, traders said.
Trade was mainly in the January and March 1997 contracts with some interest in the 1998 January and March contracts.

The settlement price for January 1997 futures edged up A$1.00 to A$153.00 a tonne. "The market is definitely buoyant, there is a lot of short covering going on and there is some end user buying going on," said Phil Lindsay of Ord Minnett Jardine Fleming Futures Ltd. "People that are short futures, whether they are growers or speculators are starting to buy them back."
